title: chrysopsis oregona var. rudis
intro: Chrysopsis oregona var. rudis, commonly known as Oregon Sunshine or California Bayberry, is a shrub-like perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chrysopsis oregona var. rudis include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
